sources.role: main.c config parser and joystick.c SDL runtime-index selection and fixed input interpretation

linux-flatpak.reason: The official Oricutron source does not establish an exact six-purpose host contract (config, controller input, saves, states, BIOS/firmware, and keys).
evidence: host capture withheld until all six purposes are source-backed
